**nano.md 0.6.1 — two fixes**

- **macOS:** a `.md` file opened from Finder, or with `open`, now opens
  in nano.md. Before, nano.md started with an empty window, including
  after `nanomd --register` made it the default app. A file opened while
  nano.md is already running gets a window of its own. (#23)
- **Preview:** a table, code block or quote at the very top of a
  document now shows. Before, it was drawn off-screen to the right. (#24)

**Install:** download the archive for your platform below;
`SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all of them. Binaries are still unsigned, so
SmartScreen and Gatekeeper warn on first launch; the README's Install
section covers both.

**Platforms:** Windows x86_64, macOS arm64 and x86_64 (real `.app`
bundle), Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.35+, built on ubuntu-22.04).

Full changelog in [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/odysseia06/nanomd/blob/v0.6.1/CHANGELOG.md).
